product_metadata.title: Lush Decor Ruffle Skirt Bedspread Vintage Chic Farmhouse Style Lightweight 3 Piece Set, Full, Grey
features: Feminine, Vintage Chic style bedspread with fabric and fill content made from 100% polyester - lightweight bedding ideal for summer and spring or layering.
Lush Décor Ruffle Skirt bedspread has a long, beautiful ruffled edge detail and is the perfect addition to your farmhouse or Vintage Chic style bedroom decor.
Elegant and delicate ruffle edge give you a charming and pretty queen bedding set.
3 piece set includes a full size bedspread (75”H x 54”W + 30” drop) and 2 matching shams (20”H x 26”W + 2” ruffle).
Due to the delicate nature of the design, these items are dry clean only.
description: This solid color set is soft and luxurious feeling with beautiful ruffle detail. Because it is light weight, it is ideal for layering and for use during the spring and summer. This generously sized 3-piece set includes a bedspread and 2 matching shams.
